title: A-ROSA
short_introduction: A-ROSA brings several European city breaks together in one relaxed river journey while your comfortable floating hotel travels with you.
full_overview:
River cruises with A-ROSA

Why choose a break in just one city when a single holiday can introduce you to several? Step aboard A-ROSA and discover European destinations one after another, from tempting local cafés and lively shopping streets to unusual museums and cultural highlights.

A-ROSA ships often berth close to the centre of major European cities, placing each destination within easy reach of your cabin. Set out with your bag and camera, then explore in the way that suits you: independently or with a guide, on foot or by A-ROSA bicycle. The pace and shape of the day remain yours to decide.

While the scenery and cities change around you, your premium floating hotel travels with you. On board, you can admire the passing landscapes, enjoy a drink in the sunshine, play minigolf or make time for the spa. Whether you are relaxing in your spacious cabin, sitting beside the pool or dining in the restaurant, A-ROSA offers an easy way to drift between destinations while enjoying the holiday itself.

title: AE Expeditions
short_introduction: AE Expeditions leads small-group journeys into remote regions aboard purpose-built ships with an emphasis on flexibility and responsible exploration.
full_overview:
Small-ship expeditions with AE Expeditions

AE Expeditions is part of Aurora Expeditions, founded in 1991 by explorers Greg and Margaret Mortimer. Inspired by the belief that close, immersive encounters with wild places can change how people see and protect them, the company takes small groups into some of the world's most remote regions. Its name honours Aurora, the ship used by polar explorer Sir Douglas Mawson.

That pioneering outlook continues aboard purpose-built small ships. Their size offers the flexibility to respond to ice, tides and changing weather, while travelling with fewer guests creates more space for quiet moments, longer experiences ashore and plans shaped by the conditions. Voyages range from eight to thirty days, allowing travellers to concentrate on one region or join expeditions together for a longer adventure.

AE Expeditions presents expedition travel as something deeper than reaching a distant place. Each journey is designed to combine discovery with education and conservation, encouraging guests to return with a stronger connection to the environments they have visited.

As a Certified B Corporation and carbon-neutral operator, AE Expeditions links exploration with environmental responsibility. Its ships use modern technology and its approach is built around travelling thoughtfully through fragile destinations while helping to protect them for the future.

title: AMADEUS River Cruises
short_introduction: AMADEUS combines five-star European river cruising with the freedom to shape the journey around your own interests and preferred pace.
full_overview:
Tailor-made river cruising with AMADEUS

For AMADEUS, luxury begins with having a choice. Its five-star river journeys combine comfort and elegance with a flexible approach, giving guests room to explore according to their own interests rather than following one fixed set of inclusions or excursions.

Days can be shaped around the experiences that appeal to you, whether that means joining a carefully planned excursion, making time to relax on board or simply enjoying a drink in the Panorama Bar. The same personalised thinking can extend beyond the sailing itself through rail travel, stays before or after the cruise and longer touring arrangements.

More than forty years on Europe's rivers

AMADEUS is a traditional family-run company with over forty years of river-cruising experience. Its journeys follow some of Europe's most celebrated waterways, including the Rhine, Danube, Seine, Rhône, Moselle and Main.

Along the way, vineyards, historic cities and landmark castles unfold beside the ship. The experience is designed to make the river part of the story, bringing together memorable scenery, cultural places and the freedom to create a holiday that feels personal.

title: AmaWaterways
short_introduction: AmaWaterways offers immersive river journeys with welcoming service, regional cuisine and thoughtfully designed ships across four continents.
full_overview:
Discover the world by river with AmaWaterways

AmaWaterways creates immersive journeys aboard spacious ships designed specifically for river cruising. Warm, attentive service and food inspired by the regions along the route help connect life on board with the destinations outside.

Its cruises span Europe, Asia, Africa and South America. Guests can follow classic European rivers such as the Rhine and Rhône or travel farther afield along waterways including the Nile, Mekong and Magdalena, with comfort, flexibility and thoughtful discovery woven into the experience.

Travel into the heart of each destination

River cruising makes it possible to arrive close to historic city centres and characterful villages. From there, guests can explore with knowledgeable experts, gaining a fuller understanding of the places visited as a different view appears each day.

Multiple destinations come together in one straightforward journey, without repeated hotel changes or complicated transfers. Before- and after-cruise extensions can continue the experience, while personalised service, inviting spaces and regionally themed events bring local culture on board.

title: Ambassador Cruise Line
short_introduction: Ambassador is a British no-fly cruise line focused on affordable quality, friendly service and a welcoming community at sea.
full_overview:
Authentic no-fly cruising with Ambassador

Ambassador Cruise Line offers British guests a straightforward way to begin a cruise closer to home. Its no-fly approach is centred on affordable quality and a warm welcome from the moment guests step aboard.

Friendly service is an important part of the Ambassador experience. The line's diverse crew and sociable atmosphere give guests opportunities to form lasting friendships with fellow travellers as well as the people looking after them on board.

Together, that sense of welcome and community creates a relaxed style of cruising for guests who value both the journey and the people they share it with. Ambassador Cruise Line is based in Purfleet, Essex.

title: Avalon Waterways
short_introduction: Avalon Waterways pairs intimate Suite Ships with panoramic accommodation, personal service and a choice of ways to explore ashore.
full_overview:
A different view of river cruising

Avalon Waterways designs its river cruises around space, scenery and a more personal way to travel. Its Panorama Suites position the bed towards floor-to-ceiling windows, allowing the changing landscape to remain part of the experience even while guests relax in their cabin.

Aboard Avalon's award-winning Suite Ships, the emphasis is on generous experiences without large crowds. Daily excursion choices, included touches and attentive service give guests flexibility while the smaller scale of the ships creates a calmer atmosphere.

Smaller ships and richer experiences

Suite Ships carry around 150 guests or fewer, creating more room, time and individual attention on board. Ashore, smaller excursion groups can offer easier access to important sights, closer contact with local guides and a more considered look at the culture, history and lesser-known corners of each destination.

The boutique-hotel-inspired Panorama Suites bring elegance and ease together. Open-Air Balconies use exceptionally wide-opening windows to draw in the view, while Comfort Collection beds face the passing scenery. It is an approach that makes the river itself central to the time spent on board.

title: Carnival Cruise Line
short_introduction: Carnival Cruise Line is built around sociable, fun-filled holidays with lively entertainment, varied dining and an easy-going welcome at sea.
full_overview:
Fun at sea with Carnival Cruise Line

Carnival Cruise Line has grown steadily since it was founded in 1972 and now welcomes millions of guests. It belongs to the Carnival Corporation family alongside several other well-known cruise brands.

The Carnival experience is centred on enjoyable holidays both on board and ashore. Days and evenings can include stage productions, live music, deck parties, casinos and waterslides, giving guests plenty of ways to make the trip as lively as they wish.

Comfortable accommodation, attentive service and a choice of casual or more elegant places to eat help guests feel at home. Bars and gathering spaces can be found inside and out, creating a relaxed setting for time together between calls at beautiful ports.

Carnival offers everything from short escapes to longer cruises. Although particularly associated with the Caribbean, its itineraries also reach destinations including Mexico, Alaska, The Bahamas, Hawaii, the South Pacific, New Zealand and Asia.

title: Celebrity Cruises
short_introduction: Celebrity Cruises blends thoughtful service and intimate touches with striking ships, varied experiences and a contemporary sense of occasion.
full_overview:
An elevated way to see the world

Celebrity Cruises combines the considered service and atmosphere associated with a smaller ship with the energy, variety and facilities of a larger one. Its ships are shaped by architects, designers and landscape specialists to create distinctive spaces that connect guests with the sea and the destinations beyond.

Spacious staterooms provide a comfortable base between days ashore. Around the ship, guests can move from globally influenced dining to the Resort Deck, adults-only Solarium, live entertainment and relaxed evening venues. On Edge Series ships, the cantilevered Magic Carpet adds another memorable place to dine, drink and take in the view.

Dining and suite life

Celebrity's restaurants draw on flavours from around the world, with dishes prepared fresh on board and an extensive wine programme supported by knowledgeable sommeliers. Edge Series ships offer a particularly broad choice, including Le Voyage by chef Daniel Boulud.

The Retreat brings an additional level of privacy for suite guests. Dedicated butler service is paired with access to exclusive spaces including a private lounge, sundeck and Luminae restaurant.

Wellbeing and entertainment

Entertainment runs throughout the day and evening, from theatre productions and live music to silent discos and unexpected performances. Wellness is equally central, with eXhale bedding, fitness programmes, spa treatments and thermal experiences designed to restore both body and mind.

Families can share films beneath the stars, music, shows and activities on board, then continue the adventure through days at the beach or excursions ashore. The range allows children, parents and grandparents to enjoy time together while still finding experiences of their own.

title: Celebrity River Cruises
short_introduction: Celebrity River Cruises brings the line's elevated approach to Europe's rivers, with journeys designed around culture, scenery and city discovery.
full_overview:
River cruising the Celebrity way

Celebrity River Cruises takes the contemporary experience developed at sea and brings it to some of Europe's most iconic waterways. The aim is to place guests closer to the culture, history and memorable cities found along each route.

Every element is intended to deepen the connection with the destination, from regional flavours and changing river views to the stories behind the places visited. It is a new way to experience Europe through the familiar lens of Celebrity's elevated style.

title: Celestyal Cruises
short_introduction: Celestyal combines mid-sized ships, regional knowledge and friendly service with itineraries designed to reveal both landmark ports and hidden gems.
full_overview:
A boutique fleet with destination expertise

Whether the journey is a lively long weekend or a longer voyage, Celestyal's mid-sized ships are designed to feel like a welcoming home at sea. Award-winning service and strong regional knowledge help guests connect with both celebrated destinations and less familiar ports.

Smaller ships can reach places beyond the usual routes, while carefully timed schedules aim to avoid the busiest periods. A wide choice of excursions provides different ways to explore once ashore.

Set your own pace on board

Time at sea can be active or unhurried. Guests might join a dance lesson, practise yoga, learn some Greek or take part in poolside activities, then slow down on a sun lounger, visit the Sozo spa or retreat to their cabin. Selected suites add concierge support for an even easier stay.

Dining ranges from breakfast buffets and casual snacks to more indulgent meals. A selection of bars serves soft drinks and cocktails, while evening entertainment completes days in which the ship remains an important part of the adventure.

title: Costa Cruises
short_introduction: Costa Cruises brings Italian style and hospitality to voyages that connect guests with destinations, cultures and landscapes around the world.
full_overview:
Italian hospitality at sea

Costa Cruises has represented Italian style and hospitality for more than seventy-five years. As the only cruise line to sail under the Italian flag, it sees each voyage as an opportunity to share the character and values of Italy while welcoming guests from around the world.

From its headquarters in Genoa, Costa operates international itineraries across regions including the Mediterranean, Northern Europe, the Caribbean, the Americas, the Arabian Gulf and the Far East.

Travel shaped by discovery

Costa introduces guests to countries and cultures across five continents, with an emphasis on respecting the identity of every place visited. The destinations are not simply a backdrop to the cruise but a central part of the holiday.

Responsible innovation influences both future ship design and the experience on board. Attention to detail is used to create voyages that encourage guests to discover local cultures thoughtfully while enjoying Costa's recognisably Italian approach to travel.

title: CroisiEurope
short_introduction: CroisiEurope offers accessible river cruising across an unusually broad network of European and international waterways aboard its own varied fleet.
full_overview:
A pioneering approach to river cruising

CroisiEurope helped make river cruising available to a wider range of travellers by developing an affordable model focused on value. The company is involved throughout the operation, from designing and building ships to assembling crews and managing sales, food, maintenance and logistics.

That integrated approach supports a consistent onboard experience, with comfortable ships, attentive service and a strong emphasis on dining. CroisiEurope has also worked with renowned French chefs to develop its culinary offering.

Rivers across Europe and beyond

The Rhine and Danube remain central to the programme, joined by itineraries on waterways such as the Seine, Rhône, Tisza, Guadalquivir, Douro, Dordogne and Garonne. Farther afield, journeys reach the Mekong in Southeast Asia and Lake Kariba in Southern Africa.

CroisiEurope's pioneering spirit also extends to Adriatic sailings and intimate hotel barges on French canals. With a small number of cabins, these barges travel into regions including Alsace, Burgundy, Champagne, the Loire and Provence, offering close access to places that larger vessels cannot reach.

From European rivers and canals to more distant landscapes, CroisiEurope combines French heritage with a friendly, professional welcome and a broad choice of destinations.

title: Crystal
short_introduction: Crystal pairs spacious ships and highly personal service with refined dining, elegant accommodation and journeys to destinations around the world.
full_overview:
Welcome to the world of Crystal

Crystal welcomes guests into a warm onboard community where new friendships, familiar faces and time with loved ones become part of the journey. Its ships provide an elegant setting for voyages that range from energetic cities to remote wilderness and unspoilt beaches.

After joining A&K Travel Group in 2022, the Crystal brand refurbished and relaunched its flagships, Crystal Serenity and Crystal Symphony, beginning a renewed chapter built on three decades of luxury cruising.

Space and intuitive service

Every guest room and suite includes personal butler service, supported by a crew known for anticipating what guests need. A high level of space per passenger and a generous crew-to-guest ratio create an unhurried atmosphere that can begin to feel like a second home at sea.

Dining includes the only restaurant at sea by chef Nobu Matsuhisa, adding a distinctive culinary experience to the line's broader focus on thoughtful hospitality. Together, the food, personal attention and spacious surroundings form the heart of the Crystal experience.

title: Cunard
short_introduction: Cunard's four Queens combine grand scale, individual character and carefully considered style on journeys to familiar favourites and new destinations.
full_overview:
The Cunard Queens

Cunard's fleet is formed by four distinctive ships: Queen Mary 2, Queen Elizabeth, Queen Victoria and Queen Anne. Each has a personality and atmosphere of her own while sharing the sense of scale, occasion and finely judged style associated with Cunard.

Together, the four Queens provide an elegant setting for returning to much-loved destinations or setting out towards somewhere entirely new.

title: Disney Cruise Line
short_introduction: Disney Cruise Line combines destination discovery with dedicated spaces for children and adults, plus entertainment designed for families to enjoy together.
full_overview:
A Disney holiday for the whole family

A Disney cruise brings several kinds of holiday into one journey: time at sea, relaxing days near beautiful beaches and the distinctive entertainment and storytelling associated with Disney. Itineraries can introduce families to destinations across the Mediterranean, Northern Europe and the Caribbean before everyone returns to the ship each evening.

Something for every generation

Children aged three to twelve can enter themed worlds inspired by Disney, Pixar, Marvel and Star Wars through imaginative play areas, interactive activities, character encounters, creative studios and challenges. Tweens and teenagers have their own dedicated spaces, with music, films and video games suited to their age group.

Adults can use the time to unwind in areas reserved especially for them. Options include the spa, an adults-only pool, sophisticated restaurants and late-night entertainment, providing quieter moments alongside the family experience.

There is also plenty to share. Original stage musicals, films, deck parties, fireworks at sea and encounters with Disney characters create memorable occasions for children and adults to enjoy together.

title: Emerald Cruises
short_introduction: Emerald Cruises offers relaxed luxury through European and Southeast Asian river journeys, intimate yacht voyages and carefully chosen destination experiences.
full_overview:
River and yacht cruising with Emerald

Founded in 2013, Emerald Cruises began sailing as Emerald Waterways the following year and has developed into an award-winning operator of deluxe river cruises and luxury yacht journeys.

Its Star-Ships were designed for waterways including the Rhine, Main, Moselle, Danube, Rhône, Saône, Douro and Mekong. Contemporary suites and staterooms are joined by elegant dining, generous sun decks and innovative spaces such as indoor pools that can become evening cinemas on selected ships.

Intimate luxury at sea

Emerald's luxury yachts carry a limited number of guests, creating an intimate atmosphere across pool decks, observation areas, alfresco dining spaces and spacious suites. Personal service and considered design give the experience the feel of a private sanctuary at sea.

Yacht itineraries reach regions including the Mediterranean, Adriatic, Caribbean, Central America, Seychelles, Indian Ocean and Red Sea, while river ships sail into the heart of destinations across Europe and Southeast Asia.

Different ways to discover

The EmeraldDISCOVERY programme includes selected excursions, while EmeraldPLUS experiences offer a closer look at local life and EmeraldACTIVE options introduce a more energetic perspective. Together, they allow guests to choose a style of exploration that suits them while enjoying the ease of travelling by river or sea.

title: Fred. Olsen Cruise Lines
short_introduction: Fred. Olsen is a family-run British cruise line known for smaller ships, handcrafted itineraries and a warm, personal atmosphere on board.
full_overview:
Smaller ships and personal cruising

Fred. Olsen Cruise Lines has remained committed to smaller ships while much of the industry has moved towards ever-larger vessels. Carrying fewer guests allows the crew to offer more personal service, creates a calm and friendly atmosphere and helps avoid a crowded experience both on board and ashore.

The ships are designed to feel unmistakably nautical rather than like large resorts. Open deck areas, comfortable lounges and thoughtfully planned restaurants provide a classic setting in which guests are treated as individuals.

Itineraries created with care

A specialist planning team handcrafts each journey to combine well-known highlights with less obvious discoveries. The ships' smaller dimensions make it possible to reach lesser-known Norwegian fjords, navigate narrow waterways and pass beneath restricted bridges, as well as berth closer to the centre of fascinating cities.

For much of the year, Fred. Olsen sails from regional ports around Britain, offering worldwide itineraries from Rosyth, Newcastle, Liverpool and Southampton in the comfort of its smaller-scale fleet.

title: HX Expeditions
short_introduction: HX Expeditions draws on a heritage dating to 1896 to take curious travellers on thoughtful journeys into remote polar regions and wild places.
full_overview:
Expedition expertise since 1896

HX Expeditions has spent well over a century introducing inquisitive travellers to some of the planet's most remote and remarkable environments. Its expeditions are designed not only to reveal extraordinary landscapes but to change the way guests understand the world around them.

Journeys can bring cultural encounters, wildlife sightings and new knowledge in destinations including Antarctica and the Arctic. The intention is for guests to return home energised by what they have experienced and with a deeper connection to the shared planet.

title: Hapag-Lloyd Cruises
short_introduction: Hapag-Lloyd Cruises combines a long maritime heritage with luxury ships, expedition journeys and a refined programme of dining, wellness and entertainment.
full_overview:
A heritage at the heart of cruising

Hapag-Lloyd Cruises traces its story to the first pleasure cruise organised by Albert Ballin more than 130 years ago. That history underpins a modern range of voyages designed to make every moment on board feel memorable.

First-class facilities and polished service are paired with distinctive destinations and a broad choice of wellness, gastronomy and entertainment. Guests can choose the classic luxury of EUROPA, the contemporary approach of EUROPA 2 or a more adventurous journey aboard one of the line's expedition ships.

title: Holland America Line
short_introduction: Holland America Line offers spacious ships, polished service, destination-focused itineraries and a strong tradition of dining, enrichment and discovery.
full_overview:
A long tradition of worldwide cruising

Holland America Line has spent more than 150 years helping travellers discover the world. Its approach is founded on the belief that travel can broaden perspectives, create connections and strengthen a sense of shared humanity.

Comfortable, spacious ships are matched with attentive service, considered dining and a varied programme of activities and enrichment. The atmosphere combines modern facilities with the character of classic ocean travel.

Itineraries span all seven continents, connecting popular ports with less-travelled places across Alaska, the Caribbean, Europe, Mexico, South America, the Panama Canal, Australia, New Zealand and Asia. Longer and more unusual journeys can reach destinations including the Amazon and Antarctica.

The line also encourages guests and employees to contribute to the communities touched by its voyages through charitable support, local projects and fundraising. This sense of responsibility sits alongside a commitment to making every guest feel genuinely welcome on board.

title: Hurtigruten
short_introduction: Hurtigruten draws on more than 130 years of Norwegian coastal sailing to offer flexible, immersive journeys into the heart of its home country.
full_overview:
Norway from the coast

Hurtigruten has sailed the Norwegian coastline since 1893, linking communities, carrying generations of local passengers and welcoming travellers who want to understand the country from the water.

Its journeys follow a simple idea: experience Norway in the way that suits you. Voyages range from a few days to several weeks, travelling from southern fjords towards the far north and Svalbard in step with the natural rhythm of the coast. Rail journeys and land touring can be combined with a sailing for a broader exploration of Norway and the Nordic region.

Stepping aboard means becoming part of a living coastal tradition rather than simply observing it. Generations of local experience help Hurtigruten bring guests closer to the landscape and the people who live along the route.

Smaller ships can follow sheltered waterways beyond the reach of larger cruise vessels, calling at quiet harbours, passing through narrow straits and visiting remote communities. The result is a close-up view of Norway shaped by the coast itself.

title: MSC Cruises
short_introduction: MSC Cruises combines international dining, large-scale entertainment and family-friendly experiences with a broad choice of itineraries around the world.
full_overview:
A global cruise experience with Mediterranean roots

MSC Cruises draws on a long family connection with the sea and turns that heritage into voyages built around discovery. Guests can expect international dining, ambitious entertainment and award-winning programmes for families in an environment designed to be welcoming and immersive.

A wide choice of durations and destinations makes it possible to shape the holiday around where and how long you want to travel. Itineraries are planned to reveal the sights, sounds and flavours of different cultures across five continents.

Ships sail throughout the year from the UK, Mediterranean and Caribbean, including calls at Ocean Cay MSC Marine Reserve in The Bahamas. Seasonal programmes extend to Northern Europe, the Canary Islands and Madeira, the Americas, Alaska, the Arabian Gulf, South Africa and Asia.

While MSC's Mediterranean heritage runs throughout the fleet, elements of the onboard experience are adapted to the region in which each ship sails. Food, entertainment and familiar touches reflect local guests and departure markets, creating differences from one part of the world to another while English remains the principal language used on board.

title: Norwegian Cruise Line
short_introduction: Norwegian Cruise Line offers a flexible contemporary cruise experience without assigned dining times, fixed entertainment schedules or formal dress codes.
full_overview:
Freedom and choice at sea

Norwegian Cruise Line has spent more than five decades developing a more flexible style of holiday. Its approach allows guests to shape days around their own timetable, without assigned dining or entertainment times and without a formal dress code.

That freedom continues through a broad selection of places to eat, live entertainment, accommodation and activities. Personalised service supports guests whether they want a lively programme or a more relaxed pace.

Norwegian sails contemporary ships to destinations around the world, including Great Stirrup Cay in The Bahamas and Harvest Caye in Belize. The range of itineraries and onboard experiences is intended to give different kinds of traveller more ways to enjoy their time at sea.

title: Oceania Cruises
short_introduction: Oceania Cruises centres its small-ship luxury experience on carefully crafted cuisine, destination-rich itineraries and a relaxed country-club atmosphere.
full_overview:
Culinary and destination-focused cruising

Oceania Cruises combines luxurious small ships with a strong focus on food and the places visited. Its intimate scale allows itineraries to include celebrated cities as well as smaller boutique ports across all seven continents, on voyages ranging from shorter escapes to extended world journeys.

Designer-inspired surroundings create a comfortable setting for days at sea, while carefully curated itineraries give guests more opportunities to explore ashore. The atmosphere is refined but relaxed, with a country-club style rather than rigid formality.

Dining at the heart of the voyage

The culinary programme is central to Oceania's identity. Guests can choose from distinctive speciality restaurants as well as in-suite and in-stateroom dining, with careful attention paid to ingredients, presentation and service.

A wide selection of amenities is included across voyages, with benefits such as speciality dining, shipboard gratuities, Wi-Fi, selected drinks, fitness classes and laundry services forming part of the wider experience. Exact inclusions should always be checked for the chosen sailing.

Warm service, detailed planning and a balance of comfort, value and destination discovery bring the experience together for travellers who want both a memorable ship and a rewarding time ashore.

title: P&O Cruises
short_introduction: P&O Cruises is a leading choice for British holidaymakers seeking to begin an award-winning cruise directly from the UK.
full_overview:
British cruising from the UK

P&O Cruises welcomes more British holidaymakers on cruises departing from the UK than any other cruise line. Its approach and onboard experience have earned awards voted for by both guests and travel-agent partners.

title: PONANT EXPLORATIONS
short_introduction: PONANT EXPLORATIONS combines intimate French-flagged ships, expert-led discovery and refined hospitality on journeys to secluded shores.
full_overview:
Exploration in comfort and style

For more than thirty-five years, PONANT EXPLORATIONS has taken guests beyond busy maritime routes and closer to majestic landscapes and ancient cultures. Expedition leaders, naturalist guides, lecturers and scientists share their experience both on board and throughout the journey.

The fleet ranges from the company's celebrated sailing yacht Le Ponant to Le Commandant Charcot, a hybrid-electric vessel designed for high-polar exploration. Despite their differences, the ships retain an intimate scale and sail beneath the French flag.

Different ways to explore

PONANT's collections offer distinct approaches to a destination, from timeless voyages and cultural discoveries to more adventurous expeditions. In secluded regions, local communities and naturalist teams help shape an immersive all-inclusive experience.

Exploration can include Zodiac outings, guided walks, small-group hikes and meetings with people whose traditions have been sustained across generations. Lectures provide further insight into the wildlife, landscapes and cultures encountered along the route.

French hospitality remains part of the experience at sea. Personal service, fine dining and carefully chosen partners complement the sense of discovery, creating voyages that join remote horizons with elegance and comfort.

title: Pandaw
short_introduction: Pandaw explores remote and challenging rivers aboard handcrafted small ships with an informal atmosphere and a distinctive sense of character.
full_overview:
Small-ship adventures on remote rivers

Pandaw specialises in travelling along rivers that are remote and often difficult to navigate. Its small luxury vessels are designed specifically for these journeys, helping guests reach places beyond the usual cruise routes.

Handcrafted in brass and teak, each ship has an identity of its own. The experience differs markedly from a large ocean cruise, with a small scale and a relaxed, notably friendly atmosphere on board.

title: Paul Gauguin Cruises
short_introduction: Paul Gauguin Cruises offers intimate South Pacific voyages shaped by Polynesian hospitality, personalised service and close access to island destinations.
full_overview:
Luxury rooted in the South Pacific

Paul Gauguin Cruises combines attentive onboard service with an authentic connection to French Polynesia and the wider South Pacific. Local Tahitian hosts and entertainers, known as Les Gauguines and Les Gauguins, share stories, performances and cultural knowledge while helping create a warm and personal atmosphere.

The line's ship, the m/s Paul Gauguin, was designed for the shallow waters and lagoons of the region. Her smaller scale allows access to intimate ports that larger cruise ships cannot reach, bringing guests closer to island landscapes and communities.

Life aboard The Gauguin

Ocean-view accommodation, selected private balconies, gourmet dining and a spa are joined by an outdoor pool, fitness facilities, boutique shopping and live entertainment. A watersports marina supports kayaking, paddleboarding and scuba-diving programmes directly from the ship.

Exclusive experiences include Motu Mahana near Taha'a, where food, drinks and live music accompany a private-island day, as well as a beach retreat in Bora Bora. Throughout the voyage, informal luxury and genuine Polynesian hospitality help the ship reflect the destinations through which she sails.

title: Princess Cruises
short_introduction: Princess Cruises combines welcoming service and strong value with voyages designed to introduce guests to remarkable destinations.
full_overview:
Discover the world with Princess Cruises

Princess Cruises invites guests to set sail for memorable destinations while enjoying friendly service and a holiday designed to offer excellent value.

title: Regent Seven Seas Cruises
short_introduction: Regent Seven Seas Cruises offers spacious all-suite ships, highly inclusive luxury and extensive opportunities to explore destinations ashore.
full_overview:
All-inclusive ultra-luxury cruising

Regent Seven Seas Cruises brings together elegant ships, generous personal space and a highly inclusive approach to luxury travel. Its voyages reach hundreds of ports around the world, with a broad programme of shore excursions helping guests experience each destination in their own way.

Spacious suites provide a private retreat at sea, many with their own balcony and an ever-changing view. During the day, onboard speakers and local guides add context to the places visited through talks, tours and culinary encounters.

Back on board, speciality restaurants create memorable settings in which to revisit the day's discoveries over dinner. Evening entertainment follows before guests return to the comfort of their suite.

Warm, attentive hospitality sits at the centre of the experience. The crew look after the details while guests personalise the voyage through additional choices and experiences. Exact inclusions should always be checked for the selected sailing.

title: Royal Caribbean International
short_introduction: Royal Caribbean International is known for innovative ships that combine adventurous attractions, ambitious entertainment and broad family appeal.
full_overview:
Innovation and adventure at sea

Royal Caribbean International has pursued new ideas at sea since 1969. Each generation of ships has introduced fresh architecture, activities and experiences designed to make the vessel itself a major part of the holiday.

Across the fleet, adventurous attractions sit alongside extensive dining, spectacular entertainment and accommodation for different kinds of traveller. Oasis Class ships are arranged around distinctive neighbourhoods, while Quantum Class introduced experiences such as simulated skydiving and surfing.

Icon Class takes the large-resort concept further with expansive waterparks and a strong focus on family facilities. Together with the rest of the fleet, these ships offer lively holidays for guests who want plenty to see and do between destinations.

title: Saga Cruises
short_introduction: Saga Cruises provides ocean and river holidays created exclusively for travellers over 50, with personal service and an emphasis on inclusive value.
full_overview:
Cruising designed for travellers over 50

Saga began arranging holidays for retired guests in 1951 and has since become a recognised British lifestyle and travel brand for people over 50. It launched its own ocean cruise line in 1997, bringing its established approach to service into life at sea.

Boutique ocean cruising

Purpose-built sister ships Spirit of Discovery and Spirit of Adventure combine contemporary surroundings with familiar elements of classic cruising. Full wraparound promenade decks and single-sitting dining across several restaurants sit alongside a boutique scale, attentive crew and an all-inclusive approach.

The ships were developed with extensive guest feedback in mind, creating an experience shaped around the preferences of Saga travellers rather than adapting a general cruise product.

River journeys through Europe

Saga's river-cruise experience reaches back to the 1990s. Its modern Spirit river ships were purpose-built to reflect the same operating values, with comfortable contemporary interiors, high service standards and itineraries along well-known European waterways.

title: Scenic Ocean Cruises
short_introduction: Scenic Ocean Cruises combines six-star Discovery Yachts, all-suite luxury and advanced exploration technology on voyages across all seven continents.
full_overview:
Discovery Yachts designed for exploration

Scenic Eclipse and her sister Discovery Yacht bring innovative design, advanced technology and refined facilities together in an intimate ocean-cruise experience. Their worldwide voyages reach polar regions, Australia and the South Pacific, Europe and the Mediterranean, the Americas and Asia.

The yachts are intended for both adventurous explorers and guests who value elegant surroundings. Depending on the voyage and conditions, optional helicopter and submersible experiences can offer new perspectives above and below the horizon.

Luxury between discoveries

Every suite includes butler service, creating a private and comfortable retreat after time ashore. A varied collection of dining venues, bars and lounges gives guests choice throughout the day, while dedicated wellness spaces provide room to slow down and recharge.

The result combines far-reaching exploration with a polished onboard experience, allowing guests to encounter remarkable oceans and waterways without leaving luxury behind.

title: Seabourn
short_introduction: Seabourn offers all-suite ultra-luxury cruising and expeditions aboard intimate ships with yacht-like surroundings and highly personalised service.
full_overview:
Intimate ultra-luxury at sea

Seabourn believes that travelling well can enrich people's lives. Its small ships combine the atmosphere of a private yacht with the ease of an all-inclusive voyage, creating an elegant home from which to explore all seven continents.

Every suite faces the ocean, providing generous personal space and a direct connection with the sea. Gourmet dining, premium wines and spirits and intuitive service are woven into the experience, while unpacking once makes it possible to move between destinations without sacrificing comfort.

Seabourn helped establish the modern style of small-ship ultra-luxury cruising. A high crew-to-guest ratio supports personal attention, and the intimate scale encourages guests to share memorable moments with like-minded travellers. Many return because that blend of service, space and sociable adventure feels distinctively Seabourn.

title: Silversea
short_introduction: Silversea combines all-suite luxury, highly inclusive service and classic or expedition voyages reaching remarkable destinations on every continent.
full_overview:
All-inclusive luxury and expedition cruising

Founded in 1994 and now part of Royal Caribbean Group, Silversea is known for both refined classic cruises and adventurous expeditions. Its small ships create an atmosphere of space, elegance and understated luxury while taking guests deep into destinations across all seven continents.

Butler service is provided in every suite category. A choice of restaurants, round-the-clock in-suite dining and premium drinks throughout the ship form part of a highly inclusive onboard experience.

Travel shaped by the destination

Silversea continues to develop programmes that connect life on board with the places visited. S.A.L.T. uses regional food and drink to explore local culture, while the Otium wellness programme takes inspiration from Roman ideas of comfort, pleasure and indulgence.

The expedition fleet reaches remote environments including both polar regions, pairing purpose-designed ships with expert-led discovery. Classic voyages take a more traditional luxury approach to iconic cities and less familiar ports, blending carefully planned itineraries with sophisticated life on board.

title: Star Clippers
short_introduction: Star Clippers recreates the romance of nineteenth-century sailing aboard authentic tall ships with the relaxed atmosphere and amenities of a private yacht.
full_overview:
The romance of sailing under canvas

Since 1991, Star Clippers has offered an alternative to conventional cruising through faithful recreations of the great clipper ships of the nineteenth century. Created by Swedish entrepreneur Mikael Krafft, the experience is designed around harmony with the sea and visits away from heavily crowded ports.

Star Clipper and Star Flyer are four-masted barquentines with a casual but elegant yacht-like character. Open-seating dining, an indoor-outdoor Tropical Bar, an intimate piano lounge and an Edwardian-style library are complemented by polished timber, brass detailing and artwork celebrating historic sailing ships.

Royal Clipper

The five-masted Royal Clipper was inspired by the historic Preussen and combines the grandeur of the sailing age with modern navigation and contemporary comfort. Her interiors continue the warm Edwardian theme, with traditional nautical details shaped by specialist yacht design.

Whenever conditions allow, Royal Clipper travels beneath sail, with an experienced crew handling the rig from the deck. Across the fleet, this active connection with wind and water gives guests a very different perspective from life aboard a large resort ship.

title: Swan Hellenic
short_introduction: Swan Hellenic combines small-ship expedition travel with cultural insight, scientific discovery and expert-led exploration in sophisticated surroundings.
full_overview:
Cultural expedition cruising

Swan Hellenic pioneered cultural expedition cruising in the 1950s, when members of the Hellenic Society travelled around ancient Greece accompanied by distinguished scholars. The success of those early journeys established a style built around bold itineraries, specialist lecturers and refined comfort on board.

More than seventy years later, the same curiosity continues to shape its voyages. Geographical exploration is combined with cultural and scientific discovery, giving guests the opportunity to look beyond the landscape and understand the places they encounter in greater depth.

title: The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection
short_introduction: The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection brings the brand's personalised service and refined hospitality to intimate all-suite voyages with the freedom of yachting.
full_overview:
The Ritz-Carlton experience at sea

The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection combines the polished lifestyle of The Ritz-Carlton with the relaxed freedom of a private-yacht holiday. Its bespoke voyages explore the Mediterranean, Caribbean and Central America, mixing distinctive destinations with carefully created experiences ashore.

Itineraries commonly include overnight calls, allowing more time to experience a port beyond a conventional daytime visit. The yachts' intimate scale supports a casually elegant atmosphere rather than the pace of a large resort ship.

Spacious suites have their own private terraces, while elevated dining, luxury amenities and highly personalised service reflect the standards associated with The Ritz-Carlton on land. The collection is designed for travellers who want both the comfort of a luxury hotel and the flexibility of a yacht journey.

title: UNIWORLD Boutique River Cruises
short_introduction: Uniworld creates all-inclusive luxury river journeys aboard individually designed ships that feel like floating boutique hotels.
full_overview:
Boutique river cruising since 1976

Uniworld began sailing in Europe in 1976 and has built decades of river expertise, local relationships and destination knowledge. Its itineraries now reach beyond Europe to rivers in Egypt, India, Southeast Asia and the Peruvian Amazon.

One-of-a-kind floating hotels

Each ship is individually designed to reflect the region through which it travels. Bespoke fabrics, local craftsmanship, original details and exceptionally comfortable furnishings create the character of a boutique hotel, complemented by personal service, regional dining and carefully chosen activities.

No two vessels are intended to feel alike. Many share creative links with the Red Carnation Hotel Collection, bringing a hotel-led eye for design to the river while allowing guests to wake in a new destination each day.

All-inclusive luxury with personal service

Uniworld's inclusive approach is built around quality, from locally sourced food and premium wines to finely considered details in each suite. Inclusions vary in some regions, so the arrangements for a chosen itinerary should always be checked.

A strong crew-to-guest ratio supports warm, individual service. Team members learn guests' preferences quickly, helping the atmosphere feel personal and familiar from the beginning of the journey to the moment they return for another sailing.

title: VIVA Cruises
short_introduction: VIVA Cruises offers flexible all-inclusive river journeys through Europe with modern ships, gourmet dining and a strong emphasis on personal choice.
full_overview:
Europe by river with VIVA Cruises

VIVA Cruises invites guests to experience Europe from its great waterways with good company, fresh perspectives and attentive service. Journeys follow rivers including the Douro, Danube, Elbe, Moselle, Rhine, Rhône and Seine, as well as the Main-Danube Canal, reaching historic towns, villages and major capitals.

Flexibility and choice shape the experience. Stylish modern ships, adaptable dining times and onboard wellness facilities allow guests to settle into a pace that suits them while each route brings a new destination into view.

VIVA All-Inclusive

The inclusive approach covers full-board dining, a selection of drinks, a replenished minibar, Wi-Fi and gratuities, with details such as high tea offered on selected journeys. As inclusions can evolve, the exact arrangements should be confirmed for the chosen sailing.

VIVA Boutique

VIVA Boutique adds a more intimate, hotel-inspired style of river travel. Renovated ships feature a high proportion of suite accommodation, multiple restaurants, wellness retreats and dedicated entertainment.

Journeys are shaped around the character of their regions, from French culture along the Seine to Italian food and lifestyle on the Po. The concept pairs the ease of waking in a different city with the design and service of a contemporary boutique hotel.

title: Viking Ocean Cruises
short_introduction: Viking Ocean Cruises offers destination-led journeys aboard intimate Scandinavian-designed ships with all-veranda accommodation.
full_overview:
Elegant small-ship ocean journeys

Viking sails intimate ocean ships across Scandinavia and Northern Europe, the Mediterranean, Asia, Australia and New Zealand, the Caribbean and the Americas.

Designed for 930 guests, the ships combine calm Scandinavian interiors with a veranda for every stateroom. Public spaces are accessible to all guests, including the Nordic Spa and the complete collection of onboard restaurants, creating a straightforward and serene experience at sea.

title: Viking River Cruises
short_introduction: Viking River Cruises combines contemporary ships, destination-focused itineraries and included touring across rivers in Europe and beyond.
full_overview:
Travel into the heart of each destination

Viking operates an extensive fleet of river vessels, including its award-winning Longships, on itineraries through Europe, Egypt, Asia and along the Mississippi in the United States.

Spacious contemporary surroundings, carefully prepared food and selected wines create a comfortable life on board. Ashore, expert-led tours introduce the culture, customs and cuisine of each place, while an inclusive package brings together the main elements needed for the journey.

title: Virgin Voyages
short_introduction: Virgin Voyages offers an adults-only alternative to traditional cruising with a restorative, contemporary and award-winning holiday experience at sea.
full_overview:
An adults-only voyage at sea

Virgin Voyages is designed for travellers who may not think of themselves as traditional cruise guests. Its adults-only approach reframes the holiday around contemporary luxury, time to restore and a distinctive experience on the water.

The result is intended to feel less like a conventional cruise and more like a modern voyage for adults seeking something different at sea.

title: Windstar Cruises
short_introduction: Windstar Cruises uses intimate sailing and all-suite yachts to bring guests closer to smaller ports, local cultures and destination-rich journeys.
full_overview:
Small ships that travel closer

Windstar's yachts carry between 148 and 342 guests, creating the time, space and freedom to become immersed in both the journey and the destination. Their small scale allows them to move beyond the routes and ports available to larger ships.

Itineraries are port intensive, often including less accessible landfalls, late departures and overnight stays. Exploring in smaller groups can make encounters with local places feel more natural and less intrusive, while intimate excursions reveal culture beyond the headline sights.

Two distinctive styles of yacht

The fleet offers the iconic sailing yachts of the Wind Class and the all-suite vessels of the Star Plus Class. Journeys are planned around the strengths of each style, whether navigating between the islands of Tahiti or following the fjords of Norway.

Personal service and a yacht-like atmosphere keep the experience relaxed on board, while carefully selected routes ensure the destination remains at the centre of every voyage.
